prompt: Single continuous shot. Leftover rice tumbling from a container into a big bowl, shredded chicken raining in, corn cascading, cream poured in a spiral. Hands fold it all with a wooden spoon in macro, then press it into a baking dish and bury it under a snowfall of grated cheese. Money shot: pulled from the oven, the cheese crust blistered golden, a spoon breaking through with a crack and lifting a stretching, steaming scoop, backlit. Warm side light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the cheese snowfall, then the crust crack. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
As sobras do domingo viram OUTRO prato — não requentado.
🧾 3 xíc. de arroz de ontem · sobras de carne/frango desfiado · 1 lata de milho · 200g de queijo · 1 caixinha de creme de leite
1. Mistura tudo menos metade do queijo. 2. Forma untada, queijo por cima. 3. Forno 200° por 20 min até gratinar.
💡 Arroz de ontem é MELHOR aqui: soltinho e seco, ele absorve o creme sem virar papa. Salva pra segunda que vem 📌
